narrator.instruct: Fast-paced, energetic, punchy explainer narrator. Brisk delivery with no long pauses.

friend.instruct: Excited, bubbly party guest shouting happily over music.

astronomer.instruct: Calm, dry, matter-of-fact scientist delivering awkward news.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It's October first, and your horoscope just called you perfectly balanced.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You're a Libra. Charming, fair, the scales of the zodiac.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You buy the Libra mug and get the scales tattooed on your arm.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your neighbor, the astronomer, waves from her telescope.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At your birthday party, everyone agrees with you.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: You are so Libra!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then the astronomer walks in, holding a star chart.

lines.speaker: astronomer
lines.text: On your birthday, the sun was in Virgo.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your sign says the sun was in Libra. The sky says it wasn't.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Sign dates were fixed over two thousand years ago, by watching the sky.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But Earth wobbles like a spinning top.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One full wobble takes about twenty-six thousand years.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every seventy-two years, the sky shifts one degree.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Today the sun sits in Virgo from about September sixteenth to October thirtieth.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It only reaches Libra around October thirty-first.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: To the Greeks, Libra wasn't scales at all.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Those stars used to be the claws of the Scorpion.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Romans cut the claws off and made them scales.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Its two brightest stars are still named Northern Claw and Southern Claw.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your friend laughs. She's a Scorpio.

lines.speaker: astronomer
lines.text: Actually, you're probably a Libra.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She's already buying the mug.
